patterns.note: Viewport-locked corner branding where 'GREAT' is anchored top-left and 'GOOD SECRETS' is anchored bottom-right, framing the hero screen.
Inline emoji integration within large-scale display typography to add a playful, informal tone to editorial statements.
High-contrast, vibrant color-blocked sections (lime green, periwinkle blue, deep violet, black) that segment the narrative flow without borders.
Scroll-driven viewport transitions where massive text blocks and solid color panels slide up to completely replace the previous screen state, creating a hard-edge wiping effect.

technique_notes: To rebuild this design, use CSS Grid and absolute positioning to anchor display typography to the extreme corners of the viewport. Implement a scroll-driven animation system using GSAP ScrollTrigger to handle the transition between full-bleed color-blocked sections, creating a hard-edge sliding or wiping effect as the user scrolls. Integrate custom SVG emojis inline with the text, scaling them proportionally with fluid typography using container queries or viewport units.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, ultra-condensed display headings with minimal, tiny sans-serif utility labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp edges with zero border-radius on sections and content blocks to maintain a brutalist aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy with massive vertical margins, dedicating entire viewports to single short phrases or single cards.

standout: The site stands out through its unapologetic brutalist minimalism, framing the entire viewport with giant, corner-docked typography and using vibrant, solid color blocks to transition between content phases.
